behaviours.note: humanControlled skip lifted for a Modern seat's engaging unit, labelled Q271 sc2 / C272; Classic (realms == 0) keeps the original's guard order
every verb clears unit +0x2A halted; BattleUnit_Order (00470000.c:4297-4413) never writes it, only FieldFoot/FieldMelee's commit-counter arm (00480000.c:4404) does
woodland argument is a literal false; Battle_OrderSelection passes DAT_0053E874 (00430000.c:7318), so a Modern missile unit ordered onto woodland never gets targetCell or the pull-back
BattleUnit_Reform runs at order time, unguarded; its one caller is Battle_UpdateAllUnits when reTarg (0x14 after an order) runs out, behind BattleUnit_NeedsReform (00480000.c:3651-3656)
minFigures 1; the cited 8/9 radii come from Enemy_NearestUnit(unit,8,3) and (unit,9,3) at 00480000.c:4407 and :4498
charge gated on !halted; FieldFoot/FieldMelee clear halted (00480000.c:4404) and call Order_ChargeNearest every think while nearest != 0, never testing halted
cry is ATTACK or ORDERED; Battle_OrderSelection cries 3 (MOAT) on g_battleHoverSurface == 2 (00430000.c:7296-7297), which Classic's order_selection keeps
